import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
ax.set_xlim(0,12); ax.set_ylim(0,7); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
# deployed left
ax.plot([1,1],[1,5.5], color='black', linewidth=3)
ax.plot([1.6,1.6],[1,5.5], color='black', linewidth=3)
ax.plot([1,1.6],[3.2,3.2], color='black', linewidth=2)
ax.text(0.2,3.0,'backbone\n1100mm\n1-pc', fontsize=8)
# toe
ax.plot([1,2.2],[1,1], color='black', linewidth=3)
ax.text(1.2,0.5,'toe 240mm', fontsize=8)
# clusters
for y in [1.2]:
    for x in [0.7,1.9]:
        c=plt.Circle((x,y),0.4, fill=False, linewidth=2); ax.add_patch(c)
ax.text(0.2,6.0,'DEPLOYED side view', fontsize=9)
# folded right
ax.plot([5,10.5],[2,2], color='black', linewidth=3)
ax.plot([5,10.5],[2.4,2.4], color='black', linewidth=3)
ax.text(7.0,1.4,'folded LENGTH= backbone 1100 + cap 45 =1145mm', fontsize=8)
# toe folded up
ax.plot([5.2,5.2],[2.4,4.0], color='black', linewidth=2)
ax.text(4.0,3.5,'toe folded\n365 wide', fontsize=7)
# cluster envelope
c2=plt.Circle((5.5,2.2),0.55, fill=False, linewidth=2); ax.add_patch(c2)
c3=plt.Circle((10.0,2.2),0.55, fill=False, linewidth=2); ax.add_patch(c3)
ax.text(6.5,3.0,'WIDTH= frame 310 +2x35 clusters =380mm', fontsize=8)
ax.text(6.5,2.6,'THICK= cluster dia 370/2? radius185 +plate =190mm', fontsize=7)
ax.text(5.0,5.5,'FOLDED flat for van floor, brake locked', fontsize=9)
ax.text(5.0,5.0,'van door 1120x1235 floor 1802x1535', fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=120)
